instruction: Courtyard guesthouse from scratch. In Archicad, create a new one-storey courtyard guesthouse using real BIM elements for storey, slab, roof elements, and IfcSpace zones. Save an IFC4 export to C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc. The IFC must contain exactly one IfcBuildingStorey, exactly ten IfcSpace zones on that storey, at least one slab element, at least four roof elements, and unique IFC GlobalId values for exported root objects. Create GUEST-1 20.0 m2, GUEST-2 20.0 m2, GUEST-3 24.0 m2, GUEST-4 24.0 m2, GUEST-5 20.0 m2, GUEST-6 20.0 m2, RECEPTION 28.0 m2, LINEN 12.0 m2, LAUNDRY 40.0 m2, and COURT 80.0 m2. Each listed area must be within +/-0.10 m2. The six guest rooms together must be between 127.0 and 129.0 m2, COURT must be between 79.0 and 81.0 m2, and the total zone area must be between 287.0 and 289.0 m2. The courtyard and roof may be represented in any reasonable exporter-compatible BIM form that preserves these required elements and quantities. [Software] Launch ArchiCAD with `C:\Program Files\Graphisoft\Archicad 27\Archicad` (adjust version/path).
